name: Shorty
bio: A man called 'Shorty,' described by the paper as a handler of buffalo horns, lost the fat men's race at Medora's Fourth of July sports in 1885. In July 1886 he returned with Frank Foster's crew of butchers as one of the previous year's men.

moments.label: Lost the fat men's race on the Fourth

Frank Foster and wife arrived in Medora last Thursday evening. With them came a force of butchers, including "Shorty" and Cranston of last year's men.
